claude-subscription.title: Connect Claude account
claude-subscription.codePlaceholder: Paste the code shown in your browser
claude-subscription.codeHelp: Enter a code only if one is shown.
claude-subscription.codeClaimed: The original code submission is being confirmed. It will not be sent again.
claude-subscription.nameHelp: Enter a name to identify this signed-in account.
claude-subscription.validationHeading: Claude Code validation did not complete.
claude-subscription.failed: Claude sign-in failed. Inspect the original operation and Runner Device.
claude-subscription.noRunner: No verified Claude Runner is available in this page. Check Connections.
claude-subscription.requestUnconfirmed: The original request could not be confirmed. Keep this operation and retry only its original request.
claude-subscription.statusUnconfirmed: The original sign-in status could not be verified. No new sign-in will start.
claude-subscription.browserFailed: The browser could not be opened. Open the original page again.
claude-subscription.codeUnconfirmed: The code result is uncertain. Wait for original sign-in or cleanup; do not submit it again.
claude-subscription.canceling: Cancellation requested. Waiting for original native cleanup.
claude-subscription.cancelUnconfirmed: The original cancellation could not be confirmed. Wait for the sign-in status.
claude-subscription.nameUnconfirmed: The account name could not be saved. The connected account is kept.
claude-subscription.availability: Claude sign-in runs on this server. Grok sign-in is not available yet.
claude-subscription.serverUpdateRequired: Claude sign-in needs a server update. Update the server, then add a Claude account. Grok sign-in is not available yet.
claude-subscription.excluded.unavailable: Runner evidence is unavailable or invalid. Check the original Runner observation again; it does not establish readiness.
claude-subscription.excluded.disabled: This Runner is disabled. Ask the server administrator to enable it, then check again.
claude-subscription.excluded.capability: This Runner does not report native Claude subscription support (capability 20). Ask its administrator to update DeliDev, then check again.
claude-subscription.excluded.missing: Claude Code was not found on this Runner. Install Claude Code on that computer or correct its selected executable path, then inspect it again.
claude-subscription.excluded.duplicate: This Runner reports duplicate Claude Code installations. Ask its administrator to correct the installation observation, then check again.
claude-subscription.excluded.unchecked: Claude Code has not been inspected yet. Open Runner Devices to inspect the installation and explicitly verify its native protocol.
claude-subscription.excluded.permission: The Runner cannot execute Claude Code. Review executable and operating system access on that computer, then inspect it again.
claude-subscription.excluded.installatio: Claude Code inspection failed. Review the installation on that Runner and inspect it again; no readiness was established.
claude-subscription.excluded.version: This Claude Code version is not supported. Update Claude Code on the Runner, select its executable if needed, then inspect it again.
claude-subscription.excluded.protocol: The native Claude protocol is not verified. Open Runner Devices and inspect the installation with native protocol verification enabled; version detection alone does not establish readiness.
claude-subscription.excluded.protocolFai: Native protocol verification failed. Review the installation on this Runner, then explicitly verify its native protocol again.
claude-subscription.excluded.protocolUns: This installation has no supported native protocol. Install a supported harness version on the Runner, then explicitly verify its native protocol.
claude-subscription.server.subtitle: Saved on the selected server.
claude-subscription.server.heading: Complete sign-in in your browser
claude-subscription.server.body: Sign in to your Claude account in the browser window.
claude-subscription.server.canceled: Sign-in canceled. The server confirmed cleanup.
claude-subscription.server.expired: Sign-in expired. Start again with a new account after the server confirms cleanup.
claude-subscription.server.unsupported: Review the native operation phase and error code, inspect Claude Code on this server, then try again.
claude-subscription.server.recovery: The server must confirm cleanup before another sign-in can start.
claude-subscription.server.failed: Claude sign-in failed. No account was connected. Try again with a new account.
claude-subscription.server.tokenLimits: This account uses a Claude sign-in token saved on the selected server. The token expires, cannot use Remote Control or Claude connectors, and cannot be renewed here. To reconnect, add a new Claude account.
